name: Gwion

attributes.attribute: The first incarnation of the great bard Taliesin.
Hired by Ceridwen, he stirred her cauldron for a year and a day.
He absorbed the wisdom meant for Ceridwen's son.
Pursued Gwion through a series of transformations.
Reborn from Ceridwen and became the bard Taliesin.

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Gwion was the first name of the great bard Taliesin. As a boy hired by the hag goddess Ceridwen, he stirred her cauldron, brewed for a year and a day to make her ugly son Afagddu wise. Warned not to taste the liquid, he burnt his finger and touched it to his mouth, absorbing the wisdom meant for her son. Ceridwen chased him through transformations until he became a grain of wheat. She swallowed it as a hen, grew pregnant, and gave birth to a reborn Gwion, the bard Taliesin.

okr.objective: Trace Gwion from cauldron servant to the reborn bard Taliesin.
